subject: Getting Started with Shiny Beta Server

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Getting Started with Shiny Beta Server
parts:
Dear all,

I just got started with shiny and just received the privilege of an account on shiny beta server.

I'm getting the following error for a shiny app that runs properly locally:

----------START--------------------

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in startAppDir(port = port, workerId) : Neither ui.R nor a www subdirectory was found in /home/toche/ShinyApps/demos Calls: runApp -> startAppDir Execution halted

----------END-----------------------

I have checked that the ui.R and server.R files are copied properly and that the R library (apparently) contains the necessary packages.

This is where I have placed the ui.R and server.R files:

http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demos/shiny-dynamic-matrix

The error message suggests that it's looking for the files in the demos folder and not in shiny-dynamic-matrix
 
So I'm thinking that perhaps I cannot have nested directories?

Any suggestions?

Thanks!

Below are the steps I followed:

### Connect to my account:

$ ssh to...@spark.rstudio.com


### Make directories:

$ mkdir ShinyApps
$ mkdir ShinyApps/demos
$ mkdir ShinyApps/demos/shiny-dynamic-matrix


### Open R:

$ R


### Install packages and dependencies:

$ install.packages("shiny", dependencies = TRUE)
$ install.packages("devtools", dependencies = TRUE)
$ library("devtools")
$ install_github("shiny-incubator", "rstudio")

  Would you like to use a personal library instead?  (y/n) -> y
  Would you like to create a personal library ~/R/library to install packages into?  (y/n) -> y


### Exit R:

$ q()



### Exit ssh:

$ exit


### Move to local shiny directory:

$ cd /Users/PatrickToche/R/shiny


### Copy file by file:

$ cd /Users/PatrickToche/R/shiny
$ scp shiny-dynamic-matrix/ui.R to...@spark.rstudio.com:ShinyApps/demos/shiny-dynamic-matrix/ui.R

$ cd /Users/PatrickToche/R/shiny
$ scp shiny-dynamic-matrix/server.R to...@spark.rstudio.com:ShinyApps/demos/shiny-dynamic-matrix/server.R

### Test the shiny app:
http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demos/shiny-dynamic-matrix

Here the error message appears in my browser.
